title: World Bloom — Ordinary, Yet Special Us — Episode1 Possible Pasts

meta.Event Outline: Things have been going well for Leo/need since their professional debut. One day, a change in the tree in their SEKAI brings them to a dream world—one where they never became estranged.

rows.Line: Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Magazine Reporter
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time out of your busy schedules to join us today.

rows.Speaker: Magazine Reporter
rows.Line: I promise to write an article that fully encapsulates your charm as a band, so please look forward to receiving the draft!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you as well for having us today!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Ichika & Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Nice work with that extended interview.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yikes, I was so nervous...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too...
Thank goodness we received their questions in advance.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm still having a bit of a hard time believing that the interview we just did is going to be in “REAL STAGE”.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It is the most famous magazine for rock bands.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember you being the most surprised when we heard that we'd been asked to do an extended interview with them, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, I've been reading that magazine since the time I started playing the bass.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Putting on a successful performance as the opening act for Free Cluster likely led to this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The reporters who were at that show have been talking quite a bit about all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, wait a second! Does that mean there's a chance we'll get to perform on a music program?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Us? On TV...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
That's certainly a possibility.
If anything, this is just the time to take a stab at it.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Your FizzYum Cider song is still very popular, and your name recognition is even further on the rise after Jam Fest and your opening for Free Cluster.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In any case, media exposure is a must if you wish to reach more people with your music.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And this interview is a part of that process.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Precisely. It's not just limited to Leo/need's music. Having the masses learn more about you as artists is just as important.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I hope you can all understand that there will be growing pains. We plan to do everything we can to get your name out there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, we should be thanking you.
We look forward to our continued partnership.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad that our interview ended up going so well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. When they asked us about how we formed our band, I had to slam the brakes because I came too close to talking about Miku and Luka.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, same!
I was being super careful, but I almost let my tongue slip a few times.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
To be fair, it's hard not to talk about them.
I mean, we probably wouldn't have got our band back together if it weren't for them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They were also instrumental in us becoming friends again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
True.
On the other hand, I doubt anyone would believe us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Imagine being told about a world of feelings called “SEKAI” where we met Miku and Luka, and how they gave us all this amazing advice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Good point.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What's wrong with that?!
I mean, Miku, the others and SEKAI are all our special little secret♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: More importantly, I felt so happy when that reporter said how it's nice that we're all childhood friends!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “I'm actually really jealous that you've all been so close since you were little.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But she was also surprised to hear that we'd become estranged from one another for a time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Back then, visiting Saki at the hospital was hard because it was so far away.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Then, I started losing touch with Shiho and Honami.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Things would've probably stayed that way if we hadn't met Miku and Luka...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That we're all together like this again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We aren't just back together.
We've gotten closer as friends and become a professional band, so everything's lovey-dovey-super-duper happy♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, but what if I'd gotten better sooner?!
We probably would've gotten our band back together faster, and we'd be having a nationwide tour right about now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Being a pro isn't that easy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, that's not true!
What if...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, we should hurry up and have lunch so we can go practice with Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line:
Right.
Okay.
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If Saki had gotten better sooner...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We might've been able to spend more time together during junior high.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We could've enjoyed school events together, traveled to places and created lots of fun memories.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We may've also been able to help Shiho and Honami with their problems.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But there's no use thinking about any of that now...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, hurry!
The light's gonna turn green!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, be right there!
se_run_women_001_1
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? It's so quiet for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Are Miku and the others not practicing today?
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika! Girls!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, we're looking forward to practicing with you today...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You all need to come with me. There's something I have to show you...
Station

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What are these...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The tree's covered in all these black things...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And the leaves have wilted. They look sick...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin came and told us after she noticed earlier.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it was fine yesterday, right...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, the tree looked healthy. There weren't any of these black things when we came to check on it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Can you tell what's going on, Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I've heard that mold and moss are the usual reasons behind why a plant would turn black...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But this tree isn't like the plants from your girls' world, Ichika, since feelings are what allow it to grow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, that's the thing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, for now, why don't we start by removing these black things?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wait, Ichika, I wouldn't touch those.
We don't know what they are yet.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I have a feeling that this tree is going to wither away completely if we don't do something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, I brought a handkerchief, so you don't need to worry about me. I can remove these black things without touching them directly.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe you should create multiple layers of protection. Here, you can borrow my handkerchief...

rows.Speaker: Honami & Saki
rows.Line:
Mine as well.
Mine too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Then, I'll layer all of these and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Be careful, Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Oh, these ones look fairly easy to remove.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
...!
Ichika, stop!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Girls...!!
